_note: Share cards (Open Graph / Twitter) for every Cedwyn page, made at build time by tools/og_cards.py from the Garden Gallery pieces in dist/nft-art/art/. To repoint: change a section's list or 'default' here; a re-rendered piece flows into its card on the next build (the card file name carries the source hash). Pieces chosen 27 Oct 2026 for farm and buildings with few flowers. — Sion's Tab agent

section_desc.research: The Research Library: catalogued records, a dated timeline and a register of missing records for Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough.
section_desc.wayback: The Wayback Vault: archived pages, letters and records about Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, kept as they were found.
section_desc.wiki: The Legal Wiki: the documentary archive of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, its land, family and court records.
section_desc.docs: The evidence catalogue for Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough: every document with its date, source and reference.
section_desc.maps: The Map Room: historic maps and plans of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, and the land around it.
section_desc.story: The story of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough, told through dated records.
section_desc.projects: The Project Office: plans and progress for the Cedwyn Estate projects in Wales and Patagonia.
